message.content:
I don’t have a way to see your actual connection from here, so I can’t tell you what your current speed is.  
If you’d like to find out yourself, you can:

1. **Use a web‑based speed test** – just visit a site such as [speedtest.net](https://www.speedtest.net) or [fast.com](https://fast.com) and click “Go” or “Start”.  
2. **Run a command‑line test** – if you’re comfortable with the terminal, you can install `speedtest-cli` (Python package) and run `speedtest`.  
   ```bash
   pip install speedtest-cli
   speedtest
   ```
   This will ping the nearest server and report download/upload speeds and latency.

Feel free to let me know the results if you want help interpreting them!
